first_summary: SKILL.md is rotted at three levels. The routing surface is wrong: the frontmatter description, the 'reachable from a single Agent call' table and the effort section say the Agent tool has no effort parameter and Haiku ignores effort. The reasoning built on those is wrong too: the 200K Haiku wall with its 150K threshold, the 1x/2x/4-5x/10x ladder, and the retry-math table and 40-50% figures derived from it. What survives is the structural advice: the tool-surface lever (4.3-5.6x), model-scoped caches, 'lower effort before lowering model', the sonnet/medium, sonnet/high, opus/xhigh tier pins, a bare call running at the session's effort, and the advisor attaching to every tier.
critic_summary: The first pass was thorough on the headline stale facts and mostly accurate, with one wrong line number and one overstated status. It missed the derived retry-math units and prose, the L172 effort-flip bullet, the L256 'not a prompt instruction' routing sentence, the L264 table heading, the 'Do not ship effort: on Haiku' advice, the L295 Opus rows, and several still-true-keep items (inherit resolution, model-scoped caches, advisor_rank).
